title: Session
viz_content: SELECT replace_all(concat(format_datetime(max(event_time), '%m-%d %H:%M'), ' · ', any(agent_type), ' · ', array_element(split_by_char('/', any_if(json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd'), json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd') != '')), -1), ' · ', session_id), char(39), '') AS session FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke') GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY max(event_time) DESC LIMIT 50

title: Session
description: The session picked in Session: one of the 50 most recently active, newest first. 'latest' is the most recent session with a prompt or a tool call.
viz_content: SELECT session_id, any(agent_type) AS agent, any_if(model, model != '') AS model, array_element(split_by_char('/', any_if(json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd'), json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd') != '')), -1) AS project, format_datetime(min(event_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS started, format_datetime(max(event_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS last_event, round(date_diff('second', min(event_time), max(event_time)) / 60, 1) AS minutes, multi_if(max(event_time) > now() - 5m, 'active', count_if(event_type = 'session_end') > 0, 'ended', 'idle') AS state, count_if(event_type = 'user_input') AS prompts, (SELECT count() FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND metric_name = 'llm.call') AS model_requests, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete' AND NOT tool_success) AS failed_calls, (SELECT to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens')) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke'))) AS input_tokens, (SELECT to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.output_tokens')) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke'))) AS output_tokens, (SELECT to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens')) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke'))) AS cache_read_tokens, (SELECT count() FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_security_events) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke'))) AS detections FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) GROUP BY session_id

title: Turns
description: One bar per turn, from its prompt to its last event, along the time of the session: the latest 50 turns. Pick a turn in Turn, below, to see its steps.
viz_content: SELECT concat(format_datetime(started, '%H:%M:%S'), ' ', substring(prompt, 1, 40)) AS turn, round(start_ms / 60000, 2) AS start_min, round(greatest(end_ms, start_ms + 2000) / 60000, 2) AS end_min, round((end_ms - start_ms) / 1000) AS seconds, tool_calls, failed_calls, substring(prompt, 1, 200) AS prompt FROM (SELECT if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) AS turn_id, min(event_time) AS started, to_unix_timestamp64_milli(min(event_time)) - (SELECT to_unix_timestamp64_milli(min(event_time)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke'))) AS start_ms, to_unix_timestamp64_milli(max(event_time)) - (SELECT to_unix_timestamp64_milli(min(event_time)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke'))) AS end_ms, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete' AND NOT tool_success) AS failed_calls, replace_regex(any_if(user_message, user_message != ''), '\\s+', ' ') AS prompt FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) != '' GROUP BY turn_id HAVING count_if(event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) > 0 ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50) ORDER BY started

title: Turn
viz_content: SELECT replace_all(concat(format_datetime(min(event_time), '%H:%M:%S'), ' · ', substring(replace_regex(any_if(user_message, user_message != ''), '\\s+', ' '), 1, 40), ' · ', to_string(count_if(event_type = 'tool_invoke')), ' tool calls · ', if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id)), char(39), '') AS turn FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) != '' GROUP BY if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) HAVING count_if(event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) > 0 ORDER BY min(event_time) DESC LIMIT 200

title: Steps of the turn
description: One row per step of the turn picked in Turn, above, in order: the prompt, each model request and tool call from its start to its end, waits on a person, the reply. Point at a bar for its duration, input and result. The first 200 steps are drawn. Model requests need token metrics for the turn.
viz_content: SELECT concat(lpad(to_string(n), 3, '0'), ' ', format_datetime(from_unix_timestamp64_milli(start_ms), '%H:%M:%S'), ' ', name) AS step, kind, round((start_ms - first_ms) / 1000, 2) AS start_s, round((greatest(end_ms, start_ms + 200) - first_ms) / 1000, 2) AS end_s, round((end_ms - start_ms) / 1000, 2) AS seconds, input, result FROM (SELECT kind, name, start_ms, end_ms, input, result, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY start_ms) AS n, min(start_ms) OVER () AS first_ms FROM ( SELECT if(tool_success, 'tool call', 'tool call (failed)') AS kind, tool_name AS name, to_unix_timestamp64_milli(event_time) - tool_duration_ms AS start_ms, to_unix_timestamp64_milli(event_time) AS end_ms, substring(replace_regex(tool_input, '\\s+', ' '), 1, 300) AS input, substring(replace_regex(tool_result, '\\s+', ' '), 1, 300) AS result FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) = (SELECT if(count_if(if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) = array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_turn}}'), -1)) > 0, array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_turn}}'), -1), arg_max(if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id), event_time)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) != '' AND event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND event_type = 'tool_complete' UNION ALL SELECT 'model request' AS kind, 'model request' AS name, end_ms - latency_ms AS start_ms, end_ms, model AS input, concat(to_string(input_tokens), ' input, ', to_string(output_tokens), ' output, ', to_string(cache_read), ' cache read, ', to_string(cache_write), ' cache write tokens') AS result FROM (SELECT to_unix_timestamp64_milli(event_time) AS end_ms, any(tags['model']) AS model, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.latency_ms')) AS latency_ms, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens')) AS input_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.output_tokens')) AS output_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_read_tokens')) AS cache_read, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.cache_write_tokens')) AS cache_write FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND tags['run_id'] = (SELECT if(count_if(if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) = array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_turn}}'), -1)) > 0, array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_turn}}'), -1), arg_max(if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id), event_time)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) != '' AND event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND metric_name LIKE 'llm.%' GROUP BY end_ms) UNION ALL SELECT multi_if(event_type = 'user_input', 'prompt', event_type = 'llm_response', 'reply', 'waiting on a person') AS kind, multi_if(event_type = 'user_input', 'prompt', event_type = 'llm_response', 'reply', event_type = 'notification', 'notification', replace_all(event_type, '_', ' ')) AS name, to_unix_timestamp64_milli(event_time) AS start_ms, to_unix_timestamp64_milli(event_time) AS end_ms, substring(replace_regex(multi_if(user_message != '', user_message, event_type = 'notification', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.message'), event_type != 'llm_response', concat(tool_name, ' ', tool_input), ''), '\\s+', ' '), 1, 300) AS input, substring(replace_regex(if(block_reason != '', block_reason, assistant_message), '\\s+', ' '), 1, 300) AS result FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) = (SELECT if(count_if(if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) = array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_turn}}'), -1)) > 0, array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_turn}}'), -1), arg_max(if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id), event_time)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) != '' AND event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND (event_type IN ('user_input', 'permission_request', 'permission_denied', 'notification') OR (event_type = 'llm_response' AND assistant_message != '')))) WHERE n <= 200 ORDER BY n

title: Context growth
description: Prompt size of each model request of the main agent: input tokens plus the tokens read from and written to the cache. It shows how the context grows during the session.
viz_content: SELECT event_time AS time, to_int64(sum(metric_value)) AS context_tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND tags['sidechain'] != 'true' AND (metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens' OR (agent_type != 'codex' AND metric_name IN ('llm.cache_read_tokens', 'llm.cache_write_tokens'))) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

title: Time by tool
description: Total seconds spent in each tool during the session.
viz_content: SELECT tool_name, round(sum(tool_duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS seconds, count() AS calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) AND event_type = 'tool_complete' GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY seconds DESC LIMIT 15

title: Detections
description: The last 100 security detections raised in this session, the latest at the bottom.
viz_content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT detected_at, severity, rule_id, rule_name, hook_name, tool_name, message FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_security_events) WHERE session_id = (SELECT if(array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1) IN ('', 'latest'), arg_max(session_id, event_time), array_element(split_by_char(' ', '{{filter_session}}'), -1)) FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type IN ('user_input', 'tool_invoke')) ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 100) ORDER BY detected_at
